Setup.Opening Scene: Phoenix, a rebellious artist, hides from enforcers in a dystopian society that suppresses creativity. She escapes into a hidden maintenance shaft.
Setup.Inciting Incident: Phoenix finds a familiar symbol scratched into the metal: a phoenix rising from geometric flames.
Setup.First Plot Point: Phoenix decides to join the artistic rebellion and fight back with art and light.

Sequences.Title: Phoenix's Escape
Sequences.Description: Phoenix evades enforcers, revealing her skills and determination.

Scenes.Title: Phoenix's Hideout
Scenes.Description: Phoenix enters a hidden chamber filled with confiscated artworks.

Beats.Title: Phoenix's Resolve
Beats.Description: Phoenix swears to continue fighting for artistic freedom.

Confrontation.Rising Conflict: Phoenix and her fellow artists continue their rebellion, creating art in the catacombs.
Confrontation.Increasing Tension: Phoenix discovers a sketchbook revealing that Marcus, an enforcer, was once an artist like them.
Confrontation.Midpoint: Phoenix and the artists make a pact to continue their fight, creating a symbol of infinity with their bioluminescent paint.
Confrontation.Second Plot Point: Enforcers storm the catacombs, causing chaos and scattering the artists.

Sequences.Title: Artistic Rebellion
Sequences.Description: Phoenix and the artists create art and plan their resistance.

Scenes.Title: Marcus's Revelation
Scenes.Description: Phoenix discovers Marcus's past as an artist.

Beats.Title: The Artists' Pact
Beats.Description: The artists make a pact to continue their fight.

Resolution.Climax: Phoenix stands her ground as the enforcers advance, protecting the other artists.
Resolution.Falling Action: Artists escape into the shadows of the quantum server stacks.
Resolution.Denouement: Phoenix remains alone in the catacombs, her mural flickering in the presence of the enforcers.

Sequences.Title: The Final Stand
Sequences.Description: Phoenix confronts the enforcers, allowing the other artists to escape.

Scenes.Title: Phoenix's Sacrifice
Scenes.Description: Phoenix stands alone against the enforcers, her mural flickering.

Beats.Title: Phoenix's Resolve
Beats.Description: Phoenix remains defiant, her freckles pulsing with energy.
